explication: s&box is a Source 2/.NET game engine with an editor and game runtime. A creator’s broad workflow is to open the editor, work with project content and tools, and run a game; the README establishes those product capabilities, while the tree identifies their principal subsystems. The sampled engine loop explicitly ticks and renders game, menu, and tools DLLs. Most subsystem wiring was not sampled, so the graph shows only documented product relationships and direct calls visible in source; it does not claim a complete execution pipeline.
